ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In isosceles trapezoid TWYZ, with $\angle Z \cong \angle Y$, $m\angle Z = 30x$, $\angle T \cong \angle W$, and $m\angle T = 20x$, find $\angle T$.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows trapezoid TWYZ with T and W on the top horizontal base and Z and Y on the bottom horizontal base. The angle markings show the two top angles, ∠T and ∠W, are congruent, and the two bottom angles, ∠Z and ∠Y, are congruent. Reasoning: Given m∠T = 20x and ∠T ≅ ∠W, m∠W = 20x. Given m∠Z = 30x and ∠Z ≅ ∠Y, m∠Y = 30x. The interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to 360°, so 20x + 20x + 30x + 30x = 360. Thus 100x = 360, so x = 3.6. Therefore m∠T = 20x = 20(3.6) = 72°.
